title: Your Significance and Purpose Within the Body of Christ
titleZh: 你在基督身體裡的重要性與目的
partTitle: Stir Up Love and Good Works
summaryZh: 聚會使信徒持續領受聖靈的工作，並進入神此刻強調的親密關係。
lines: But now let's move on to verse 23.
現在我們接著看第 23 節。
Let us hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering, for He who promised is faithful.
也要堅守我們所承認的指望，不至搖動，因為那應許我們的是信實的。
Let us consider one another to incite to love and good works, not forsaking our own gatherings, as is the habit of some, but encouraging one another.
又要彼此相顧，激發愛心，勉勵行善；不可停止聚會，好像那些停止慣了的人，倒要彼此勸勉。
And all the more as you see the day approaching.
既知道那日子臨近，就更當如此。
He said He would come; therefore, He will come.
祂說祂會來，所以祂必定會來。
It is impossible for Him to tell a lie.
But if the writer of Hebrews, who wrote this a few weeks ago, could send a warning that we need to pay attention to this because the day is near, then how much more can we say at this time?
不過，希伯來書的作者幾週前寫下這段話，警告我們要留意，因為那日子近了；那我們現在豈不是更要如此宣告嗎？
Do you remember the parable in which Jesus spoke of the ten virgins who needed to keep their lamps full of oil?
你記得耶穌講過十個童女的比喻嗎？她們需要讓自己的燈裡常有油。
I have a feeling that this “not forsaking the meetings, as some are in the habit of doing”—I have a feeling that this is part of a formula.
我覺得這句「不可停止聚會，好像那些停止慣了的人」，我覺得這是某種做法的一部分。
That's the wrong word, but I'll use it.
這個詞用得不太對，不過我就先這麼說。
It is God's plan that we constantly remain filled with what the Spirit of God says and does.
神的計畫是讓我們不斷被神的靈所說、所行的充滿。
So what does it mean when it says that they continually remained in the apostles' teaching?
那麼，經文說他們恆心遵守使徒的教訓，這是什麼意思呢？
I love that phrase, but we don't have a list of these doctrines.
我很喜歡這個說法，但我們沒有這些教義的清單。
We don't have a plan for what exactly you should teach in your Sunday class or in your Sunday morning service.
我們也沒有一套計畫，規定你在主日課程或主日早晨聚會中究竟該教什麼。
I think this is just my opinion, but when he talks about “the teaching of the apostles,” he is referring to one phrase from Scripture.
這只是我的看法，但當他談到「使徒的教訓」時，他指的是聖經裡的一個詞句。
There are times when the Lord emphasizes this truth in our lives.
有些時候，主會在我們的生命中特別強調這項真理。
All of this is true, but this is what He emphasizes.
這一切都是真理，但這是祂此刻所強調的。
Does this make sense to you?
He says to His disciples, “I no longer call you slaves; I call you friends.”
祂對門徒說：「以後我不再稱你們為僕人，乃稱你們為朋友。」
What does He mean by this?
祂這麼說是什麼意思呢？
Isn't being a slave valuable to you?
作僕人不也是有價值的嗎？
No, He says that the emphasis during this period is on friendship.
不是的，祂的意思是，這個時期的重點在於友誼。
We will work on this area of intimacy, on this communication, this area of friendship.
我們要在親密關係、溝通和友誼這些方面下功夫。
